symmetric_odd_decomposition constructs the half and center from any word satisfying length and symmetry; central lookup and head identities carry the literal bounds and positivity back into OddActualFiber. Both membership directions are proved.
The path enumerator is Nodup, filtering preserves Nodup, and equality of odd mirrored words implies equality of both half and center. Hence mapping to full words introduces no duplicates.
Using xs.headD z is essential and correct when the half is empty. Independent exhaustive Fin10 checks give [[v.val]] precisely when v is positive and even; otherwise the fiber is empty.
The center is read at index ss.length, known in range from the exact odd length. The default zero cannot admit a missing center. An odd first coefficient is allowed; an odd actual center is rejected.

This layer states exact fibers for encoded targets oddMirror (ss.map Fin.val) (2*v.val). The separate arbitrary-output range and Complete modules are required before claiming a theorem quantified over every raw output list r.
